briefdescription.para: The TLM2 transaction recorder.

detaileddescription.para: This module records all TLM transaction to a SCV transaction stream for further viewing and analysis. The handle of the created transaction is storee in an tlm_extension so that another instance of the scv_tlm_recorder e.g. further down the opath can link to it.
